messages.author: Chris
messages.text: I have other things I've been resentful about. in 2005 when I was sent to a hospital for mandatory mental health reasons, I was put in a box for 8 hours not allowed to bring my GBA. I was 15 at the time

messages.author: Chris
messages.text: All I remember is some bitch nurse talking to me a few times when they kept me in that box.

messages.author: Chris
messages.text: basically I was treated like an inmate because mental health services for me were non-existent practically in 2005... so it was like I was in jail.
